description: Free price check incl. value estimate (raw vs output tokens, break-even $/M). Call only to change quantity/currency or check value before buying. When Lightning payments are temporarily paused, the result includes paymentsPaused and retryAfter.

accept_terms.description: Optional. When this covers the current terms, the account stores that acceptance. The quote still does not spend sats.

baseline.description: Accepted for older clients. Savings use the page's visible text. raw is ignored.

confirm_duplicates.description: Set true only to price the same line more than once. Otherwise a repeated line is refused and nothing is charged.

items.description: Basket to price. One entry per SKU. A repeated line is refused unless confirm_duplicates is true on this call or on that line. Does not spend sats. Copy buy.quote_id into buy.

confirm_duplicates.description: Set true to allow this line to repeat.

params.description: Fields to check for this line before payment. An object, or a JSON array when that SKU body is an array.

quantity.description: How many calls to price for this line. Default 1, maximum 3.

sku.description: Catalog id or slug for this line.

params.description: Optional fields to check before payment. An object, or a JSON array when the SKU body is an array. An invalid value, including a page URL that is not http or https, is rejected. The quote does not spend sats.

quantity.description: How many calls to price. Default 1, maximum 3.

sku.description: Catalog id or slug from search_catalog. Omit when items is set.

usd_per_million.description: Your model input price in dollars per million tokens. Default 2. This does not change the Amazap price.

name: quote

outputSchema.description: The same object as the text JSON. code is set when the call stopped before delivery.

approvalUrl.description: Page where the person approves this exact price.

results.description: Search rows when this is a search result.

which.description: per_call, per_day, per_session, per_hour_buys, per_minute_calls, or per_minute_sats.
